design: paired frozen-model acquisition sensitivity on every original specimen-anatomy case

frame_thinning.replicates: all distinct phases for each stride
frame_thinning.phase: phase index; same phase within all records of each case

pose_error.unit: one independent rigid error per record

reference: fixed CT mesh and ray-visible intersections from the unperturbed complete acquisition; held-out CT used only after prediction freeze
geometry: recompute source neighborhoods, plane evidence, query-context normalization and bounded correction from available perturbed ultrasound rays
primary_representation: all deployed selected points; no held-out CT filtering
aggregation: average replicates within specimen-anatomy-condition, then equal anatomy averaging, then 14 specimens
statistical_family: PFAD versus each of the other three methods, seven changed conditions, four primary endpoints; 84 paired tests with Holm adjustment
interpretation: sensitivity to explicitly imposed retrospective acquisition changes, not new scanners, operators, clinical navigation, or acquisition validation
